decision: The competitor (Atlassian Williams Racing) is fined €5,000.
fact: Car 55 was released from the pits with floor stickers from the garage attached to the rear tyres.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 c) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the Atlassian Williams Racing team representative and reviewed video and team radio video evidence. The team advised that it had been using this floor sticker since mid season and had not previously experienced any problems with it peeling off the floor. However ultimately the team is responsible for ensuring that the car is not released in an unsafe condition and video evidence showed that the driver had great difficulty in controlling the car, thus the Stewards determine that this was an unsafe situation.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 55 Unsafe Release
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams Racing
